metadata.title: Above Avalon: Apple’s Ambient Sensing Strategy

content.text:
Happy Wednesday. Let's jump right into today's update.
Apple’s Ambient Sensing Strategy
Earlier this week, Apple surprised many people by announcing “Unlock with Front Camera” for iPhone Duo. The feature is already available in the second iOS 27.3 developer beta. The new beta includes a few other noteworthy changes including locking iPhone Duo when folding the device.
As the name applies, Unlock with Front Camera allows iPhone Duo users to leverage the front-facing 12MP Center Stage camera located on the outer display to unlock the device. The feature is not found with the inner, under-display FaceTime camera.
The technology underpinning Unlock with Front Camera was quietly unveiled last month with HomeView. Instead of relying on Face ID for authentication, HomeView uses 2D facial recognition via the Center Stage camera, along with a few other parameters such as having one’s recently unlocked iPhone on the same Wi-Fi network. At the time, Apple framed HomeView's facial recognition as merely "HomeView recognizes users by their faces..." With iPhone Duo, Apple is taking an extra step to market the feature as Unlock with Front Camera.
